key_facts: On July 25, 2024, the NIFC IMSR reported 98 uncontained large fires nationally (full-suppression only), 17 new large incidents, and National Preparedness Level 5; the Active Incident Resource Summary listed 142 total incidents and 1,611,409 cumulative acres.

On July 22, 2023, the NIFC IMSR reported 25 uncontained large fires nationally (full-suppression only), 9 new large incidents, and National Preparedness Level 3; the Active Incident Resource Summary listed 61 total incidents and 124,946 cumulative acres.

The IMSR 'Uncontained large fires' headline count includes ONLY fires managed under a full-suppression strategy; fires managed under other strategies are reported separately (12 such fires on July 22, 2023; 4 on July 25, 2024).
The 'Active Incident Resource Summary' total-incidents figure is higher than the headline uncontained-large-fires count (142 vs 98 on July 25, 2024).
Late July 2023 was an unusually quiet US season (PL 3), with significant US resources deployed to support fires in Canada.
Late July 2024 was a very active western season (PL 5), dominated by the Northwest GACC (56 incidents including the ~268,492-acre Durkee Fire).
Primary IMSR PDFs for the July 20-26 window are archived and retrievable for 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025 at nifc.gov.
As a recent live reference, NIFC National Fire News reported 74 large fires nationally on July 20, 2026, with 5 new large incidents.
